premises.text: Logos can elicit a variety of responses and convey status
premises.evidence_span: Logos are incredibly powerful. They can elicit a variety of responses, from inspiration to a fond memory, convey status, be a catalyst for change, or even bring on a food craving.

premises.text: People prefer images in messaging, as evidenced by the high volume of emoji usage
premises.evidence_span: we already know that people prefer images towards because six billion messages a day contain emojis.

premises.text: Finding and sharing information while texting is challenging
premises.evidence_span: finding and sharing information, while texting, is challenging.

premises.text: Logi provides instant access to information inside messaging through deep linking
premises.evidence_span: with Logi, you have instant access to information inside of your messaging.

premises.text: Logi aggregates data across a suite of services for easy access
premises.evidence_span: the Logi platform seamlessly provides aggregated data across a suite of services.

premises.text: Logi allows users to coordinate activities and share information without typing
premises.evidence_span: I've just coordinated grocery shopping with my friend, and I've sent her the place, the store location, and all of the pertinent brand information without typing a word.

premises.text: Logi enables users to make introductions and network through social media integration
premises.evidence_span: it's about people, too, which means I can use it to make introductions and network.

premises.text: Logi is community-sourced, allowing anyone to add logos
premises.evidence_span: it's community source, which means that anyone can get involved and add logos.

premises.text: Brands can create a holistic customer experience that extends into messaging
premises.evidence_span: any brand, big or small, can create a holistic customer experience that extends into messaging.

premises.text: Logi provides brands with tools for premium placement and data analytics
premises.evidence_span: We let a brand use their most curated asset, their logo, to sponsor it for premium placement, do branded content and customizations, app-to-app integrations, and view their logo's data analytics.

value.text: Logi enhances mobile messaging by integrating useful information and branding
value.evidence_span: the idea of people and brands connecting inside of text messaging in a helpful way is totally uncharted territory.

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships coded.
